conditional_on: today's rules; the forecast world; AI at today's pace
rule: a forecast outside its margin in two or more of the five years has failed

unemp.why: the backcast misses by 0.25 points on average with demand identified; 1 point allows for the demand shocks a forecast cannot know

emp.why: the backcast's mean miss is 1.4 points, with a bias of -1.1

infl.why: a judgement: the backcast reproduces prices only through an identified exchange-rate shock, so prices are the least tested forecast here

population.what: population on 1 January of the following year
population.why: the backcast ends 1.0% above the record in 2025

births.why: a judgement: births are fixed near 4,300 a year in the base and move only through income

poverty.what: at-risk-of-poverty rate, persons (60% of the median)
poverty.why: the model matches EU-SILC's 9.0% in 2025; the margin allows for the survey's sampling error

child_poverty.why: wider than for persons, since the survey samples fewer children
